entities.name: Louis Moreau Gottschalk
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis Moreau Gottschalk was a Louisiana Creole and Jewish-American composer, pianist, and virtuoso performer of his own romantic piano works. He spent most of his working career outside the United States.
